sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 210. Success value 100. 3x physical damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies Kismet.
-Target: all allies. Removes status ailments.
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical and magic damage taken by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies 10% Life Drain for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Grace for 60 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction, status ailments, and debuffs. After the effect ends, 100 Cost is restored to your character).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 8000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 8000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Permits piercing through damage reduction/reflection effects when attacking for 60 seconds.
Only [Booming Drum] Thunder can be used as Unlocking Potential material
